metadata.send_timestamp: float  (Unix seconds; wall-clock time when this message was sent)

sender_state._comment: Sender 6-DoF pose expressed in the WGS84 global coordinate system.

orientation._comment: Tait-Bryan ZYX angles in the local ENU tangent frame at the sender's WGS84 position. Intrinsic ZYX: R = Rz(yaw) @ Ry(pitch) @ Rx(roll).
orientation.roll: float  (degrees; rotation about local East axis)
orientation.pitch: float  (degrees; rotation about local North axis)

reference_frame._comment: Right-handed coordinate frame. Heading is measured around +z, counterclockwise from +x.

detections.track_id: int  (consistent across frames; omit or set null if untracked)
detections.timestamp: float  (Unix seconds; sensor capture time — time at which the observed scene occurred; must not include inference or transmission latency)
detections.heading: float32  (radians; yaw around z-axis, counterclockwise from +x)

optional._comment: All fields below are optional; individual fields may be omitted, or the entire 'optional' object may be omitted
optional.v: float32  (meters/second; signed speed magnitude; can be derived from vx, vy)
